title: Fair Housing Statement
content:
## Our Commitment to Fair Housing

Mallan Real Estate is committed to upholding the principles of fair housing for all. We support the Fair Housing Act and all applicable state and local fair housing laws.

## Equal Opportunity

We provide equal professional service without regard to:

- Race or color
- Religion
- National origin
- Sex or gender
- Familial status
- Disability
- Sexual orientation
- Gender identity
- Marital status
- Source of income
- Any other protected class under applicable law

## Our Pledge

All real estate advertised on this website is subject to the Federal Fair Housing Act, which makes it illegal to advertise any preference, limitation, or discrimination based on protected characteristics.

We will not knowingly accept any advertising for real estate which violates the law. All persons are hereby informed that all dwellings advertised are available on an equal opportunity basis.

## Reporting Discrimination

If you believe you have experienced housing discrimination, you may file a complaint with:

**U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD)**
- Phone: 1-800-669-9777
- Online: www.hud.gov/fairhousing

**New York State Division of Human Rights**
- Phone: 1-888-392-3644
- Online: www.dhr.ny.gov

**New York City Commission on Human Rights**
- Phone: 311 or (212) 306-7450
- Online: www.nyc.gov/humanrights

## Contact Us

If you have any questions about our fair housing policies, please contact us directly.
